events.title: Vena is in Steam Next Fest! Beginner Friendly Tutorial & New End Screen!
events.summary: Vena is in Steam Next Fest! Beginner Friendly Tutorial & New End Screen! Vena is part of Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26. Check out the demo for free for the whole week, and leave a wishlist if you like it. The Nexus is hungrier than ever! I have completely rebuilt the tutorial to make sure beginners can grasp the concept of the game more easily. It is now also suitable for players not familiar with automation games. events.title: Vena Release Date Announced & Many Bundles Coming!
events.summary: I have some exciting news to share with you. If you haven't heard it yet, Vena will release on November 9th, a bit after the participation in Steam Next Fest. There will be a few bundles coming along with the release.
